text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Electric scooters run at about ₹0.20 to ₹0.30 per km in India versus ₹2.00 to ₹2.50 per km for petrol scooters.","cited_pids":["4ad48ebaaa3c#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"For a 30 km daily commuter, annual fuel costs are estimated at ₹22,000 to ₹27,000 on petrol versus ₹2,000 to ₹3,300 on electric.","cited_pids":["4ad48ebaaa3c#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Charging a typical electric scooter costs about ₹15 to ₹50 per full charge.","cited_pids":["11111599e4c1#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Annual maintenance for an electric scooter is roughly ₹1,500 to ₹3,000.","cited_pids":["4ad48ebaaa3c#3"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Electric scooter battery replacement is a future cost that is not included in the running-cost figures.","cited_pids":["6bde68396ba8#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Electric scooter batteries last roughly 6 to 8 years.","cited_pids":["6bde68396ba8#0"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"An academic cost-per-km framework argues that annual usage is the decisive variable determining whether electric scooters save money.","cited_pids":["8482569026cb#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"The supporting sources for electric scooters' lower running costs are vendor or comparison sites with promotional tone and estimated figures.","cited_pids":[]}]}
